data.standardized_narrative: The report does not present a clear, single gross prioryear reserve movement figure in an obvious 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note accessible in the scanned pages. The syndicate reports complex and mixed reserve experience across accounts and classes in narrative sections, but a gross PYD number was not unambiguously extractable from the available pages. Gross written premium for the year is reported at GBP 39.472m.
data.data_quality_notes: The scanned images are of limited legibility. I could identify gross written premium (GBP 39,472k) on the financial indicators table (page ~5). However the key detailed technical reserves tables and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (gross Insurance liabilities column) could not be reliably read/extracted from the provided images. The balance sheet liabilities page is present (page 17) but the exact gross 'Claims outstanding' prior year (31 Dec 2013) figure could not be unambiguously transcribed. No explicit gross prioryear development amount (Insurance liabilities column) was confidently located. Accordingly opening_reserves_gbp_m and prior_year_development_gbp_m are left null rather than risk incorrect figures. If higher-resolution pages for the Technical Provisions (notes) and the liabilities table are provided I can extract the precise gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) and the gross prior year movement.
